snapshot_policy: Only the exact locally qualified Cargo package payloads are extracted under upstream/. Each payload includes Cargo's normalized and original manifests, VCS identity, lockfile, selected source/include files, and package licence/readme files. Unrelated workspace crates, bindings, generated native extensions, and sites are excluded.
